name: ferror
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fwrite(fid, [1 2 3]); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); msg = ferror(fid); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(strlength(msg) == 0);
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip via tempname). ferror returns empty string when no error.
